Manufacturer application evidence — Bosch Automotive Filters India catalogue, HCV Filter Application Chart (printed page 21), exact part 1 457 431 003, Fuel Filter Element: Ashok Leyland Artik 3014, Cheetah and Comet 1616H; Swaraj Mazda Premium WT 49 ESA, Sartaj WV26S, Super ZT54 BS I and T3500 Prestige WT49LWB; Tata 1510 LP and LPT 1613. Bosch Commercial Vehicle Filter Catalogue further gives exact Cheetah power/year variants (84 kW, 1995.04–2010.10; 97 kW, 2005.04–2010.10; 88 kW, 2000.11–2005.03). Note: the CV chart also shows this part against the 1616H 5.7 L and 1613H model variants. These catalogue applications supersede the generic Universal label for fitment lookup; confirm engine and filter housing. Sources: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/parts_11/pdf_8/bosch-automotive-filters-india-catalogue.pdf ; https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/country_specific/in/services_and_support_1/downloads_10/pdf_5/cv_filter_catalogue.pdf
